text:
sam: Quick heads-up — after enabling aggressive prefetch on the continuous-batcher for tenant-42 we saw token cost jump ~40% with no QPS increase. KV hit-rate dropped too. anyone else noticed this?
anya: interesting. got graphs? which prefetch window was enabled?
kevin: can you paste the telemetry? CPU/gpu usage looks steady?
sam: pasted a small snippet below. baseline vs prefetch=high for same traffic slice:
```
baseline: tokens/sec=18k, KV-hit=82%, cost=$0.18/hr
prefetch-high: tokens/sec=18.1k, KV-hit=47%, cost=$0.25/hr
latency p95 ~ +5ms
```
maria: whoa KV-hit drop is the killer. sounds like prefetch pulled in cold prefixes that never got reused. prefetch != caching.
kevin: makes sense — prefetch increases candidates in KV index, which can evict hot entries if headroom low. did we hit max-kv-entries or headroom?
sam: headroom dropped ~15% during the test (see infra-bot snapshot below).
infra-bot: [snapshot] node-9: kv_entries=1.2M/1.4M headroom=15% lane=default
anya: what was admission policy during that test? coalesce window same?
sam: admission didn't change, coalesce=6ms. only prefetch window expanded from 0->40 tokens.
maria: two orthogonal problems: (1) prefetch is increasing cache footprint => eviction of useful kv, (2) we overpay for tokens that don't reach commit. Tradeoffs: smaller prefetch window, lease-based prefetch (only prefetch if admission predicts >=N tokens), or lease + soft-ttl eviction for prefetched keys.
kevin: I sketched a cheap heuristic: prefetch only at enqueue when request.len >= threshold AND tenant recent_reuse_rate > X. Otherwise no prefetch. That keeps behavior per-tenant.
anya: works but need metric for recent_reuse_rate and backfill for cold tenants. Also complexity for per-tenant config.
sam: are there simpler ops knobs? like decreasing prefetch aggressiveness when global headroom < 25%?
maria: yes dynamic backpressure. Policy: if headroom < H then prefetch window = max(1, floor(prefetch*alpha)). alpha could be 0.3. Combine with tenant whitelist.
kevin: perf experiment proposal: A/B with 10% traffic using dynamic-backpressure + tenant-threshold for 6 hours. metrics: token-cost, KV-hit, p95, tail-alloc failures.
anya: can we add a debug tag to requests that enables prefetch-profile logging? will help root-cause.
sam: i'll add flag to rollout. kevin can you own metrics dashboard? maria you'll do policy impl?
maria: yep. I'll prototype in runtime feature-flag branch: prefetch.policy={static,tenant-heuristic,dynamic-backpressure}.
kevin: making dashboard: /dashboards/prefetch-impact tenant=tenant-42 variant=A/B
infra-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag branch -> staging. CI passing.
anya: follow ups: (1) safety: ensure prefetch can't drive headroom below 10% (emergency cutoff), (2) add a counter for prefetched-but-unused keys, (3) add eviction-priority tag for prefetched keys.
sam: agreed. want low-risk rollout. small canary, and auto-disable if cost delta > 10% vs baseline. :thumbsup:
kevin: timeline: i can get dashboard + metric in 2d, maria can deliver flag + runtime control in 3d, sam will run canary tomorrow.
anya: let's sync after first canary run. thanks all.
